Why does 400Mb text file take so long to load even on fast computers despite the whole file fitting inside RAM?

Because 400 megs is huge for a text file. It takes a lot of data to make a 400 meg file like that. Open up a text file and just copy and paste shit into it for a long time and save it. I bet it will be 1k of data or maybe you get it to 100k... 400 megs is nasty.

You are putting it into a text editor. Unless that editor was specifically designed to accept massive text text files in one gulp (very unlikely), it has to allocated chunks of memory for buffers, and load the file through those buffers, emptying and filling them in turn, until the whole file has been loaded once. Then it need to reload the beginning, and load up the next x buffers for the data so you can work on it.

Try opening that huge file in a hex editor and it'll just about pop right up.
